title: Vallée writes the foreword to the French edition of Virk's book

tellings.quote: I read his second book and then I and then I He asked me to write a forward for the French version, which I did, because by then I was hooked.

plain: A researcher of unexplained phenomena, Jacques Vallée, says that in the 2020s he read the second book by a writer named Rizwan Virk, and Virk then asked him to write the foreword for its French edition. Vallée says he agreed, because by then he was hooked. He tells it to show how strongly Virk's ideas had won him over.
